purpose: Check whether the concrete mod-two pivot cancellation persists over the rationals; do not assume mod-two singularity means integer singularity
candidate: At every tested invertible mod-two H_n with newest actual source one, the bordered H_(n+1) has nonzero INTEGER determinant, even when its mod-two pivot vanishes
method: Exact integer Bareiss elimination plus mod-two checks; keep all zero/invertible flags and any first counterexample
falsifier: An actual-seed n with H_n invertible modulo2, fresh source1, and det_Z H_(n+1)=0
scope: A positive finite screen does not prove the candidate or unbounded rank. This is a field-lift test of a concrete cancellation mechanism, not a large rank census.
